info.name: PlanRadar's API Documentation Approval Requests V2 Roles V2 API
Retrieve all roles for a customer

params.name: pagesize
params.description: Number of roles per page (default: 100, max: 500)

params.name: last_sync_date
params.description: Unix timestamp. Only roles updated after this time are returned

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending. e.g. 'name', '-created-on', 'is-admin-role'

items.docs: Returns all roles defined for the customer account. Supports pagination, search, sorting, and sync filtering. Each role includes a count-assigned-users attribute representing the number of distinct users assigned to that role across projects.
